I'm looking for a candidate with expertise in HCI and Machine Learning to join my Computational Interaction group at the University of Luxembourg.

This PhD position is unique in the sense that it's not tied to a particular research project; it's up to the candidate to decide the research direction.

The position is full-time for four years. More details can be found at

- Intended start date: October 2026.
- Application deadline: Not set, applications will be assessed as they arrive.
